title: I built TikTok for games where you can set your own rules and challenge your friends.
author: xaak_
selftext:
I have been building Playermakes, a mobile game feed where every game can be changed.

You can play a game instantly, describe a rule change in plain English, and AI creates a new playable version by editing the actual game code.

For example:

• Make Flappy Bird use inverted gravity  
• Let any +2 card stack in UNO

Your remix becomes a separate game with its own leaderboard, link, and creator credit. Other people can play it or remix your version.

It is still an early MVP, and I would really appreciate honest feedback:

Does remixing a game feel genuinely fun, or does it still feel like a novelty?

You can try it here: [https://playermakes.com/demo](https://playermakes.com/demo)

comments.author: xaak_
comments.body: There are about 13 games I have added so far. The next step is to let people add their original games. What games should I add in the meantime?
